name: Banh sung trau
summary: Bánh sừng trâu is on the Vietnam Tourism rural portal’s weekend-market specialty list. Báo Kon Tum quotes a visitor who wrapped bánh sừng trâu at the market. A filling was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.
howToEat: The rural portal names the cake and does not print a filling.
Báo Kon Tum’s visitor wrapped bánh sừng trâu at the market. A recipe was not printed.
A price is Check on arrival. The opening hour is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen meets on Saturday and Sunday. The Vietnam Tourism rural portal puts the pine-hill grounds on Hùng Vương in xã Măng Đen, Quảng Ngãi. Báo Kon Tum, on that portal, puts the same pine hill on Hùng Vương in thị trấn Măng Đen, Kon Plông, and another of its articles puts the market at Vườn thông by the district central square. The opening hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Banh sung trau in Mang Den
seoDescription: Bánh sừng trâu is sold at the Mang Den weekend market. A visitor on Báo Kon Tum wrapped the cake there. A filling and a price are Check on arrival.
